reviewer_notes: This is a standards/policy overview paper by JEITA about ISO 50001 and related energy-management standards; it performs no empirical modelling of its own. The only energy performance model described is a third-party vendor case (cited reports [8]/[10]) at the Saudi Aramco Abqaiq plant, whose 'Dynamic targeting' function creates calculation models fitted to changing operating conditions. Almost all model-detail fields are therefore not reported. refinery_or_petrochemical_case was coded 'refinery — model empirically applied there' because a model is described as running at the Abqaiq oil plant with reported energy savings, but this is inferred from cited reports rather than the authors' own empirical work, and Abqaiq is an oil-processing plant rather than a conventional refinery — the reviewer may prefer 'named but not an empirical application here'. The specific-energy-consumption / baseload arguments (K1, K2) are general cautions about the SEC indicator, not tied to a specific fitted model.
